name: Houston
description: America's fourth-largest city is a sprawling, multicultural powerhouse where NASA's mission control meets one of the most diverse food scenes on the planet. Houston rewards the curious — those who dig past the freeways to find world-class museums, a booming craft beer scene, and 70+ cuisines in a single metro.

identity.vibe: Sprawling, humid, fiercely multicultural metropolis that punches above its weight in food, art, and space exploration — and doesn't care if you know it yet.

nexus_grid.title: Food Capital of the South
nexus_grid.description: Houston's 10,000+ restaurants spanning 70+ cuisines make dining THE reason to visit.

nexus_grid.title: Space City Experience
nexus_grid.description: NASA's Johnson Space Center and Space Center Houston anchor the city's identity.

nexus_grid.title: Game Day Houston
nexus_grid.description: Astros, Texans, Rockets, Dynamo, Dash — plus NRG Stadium rodeo and concert circuit.

modes.label: Foodie Mode
modes.description: Houston's 10,000+ restaurants spanning 70+ cuisines — Michelin stars to taco trucks.

modes.label: Culture & Museums
modes.description: 19-museum district, world-class art, theater, and NASA.

modes.label: Nightlife
modes.description: Craft cocktail bars, breweries, live music venues, and late-night eats.

modes.label: Family Fun
modes.description: Space Center, zoo, children's museum, aquarium, parks, and playgrounds.

modes.label: Chill & Relax
modes.description: Beer gardens, park trails, hammock bars, and easy-going patios.

modes.label: Outdoor Adventure
modes.description: Kayak the bayou, run Memorial Park, bike the trails, day-trip to Galveston.

modes.label: Date Night
modes.description: Tasting menus, museum dinners, speakeasy cocktails, and sunset kayaks.

modes.label: Game Day
modes.description: Astros, Texans, Rockets, Dynamo, Dash, and the Rodeo.

transit.local_transport: You need a car. Houston is massive and sprawling. METRORail light rail covers downtown, Museum District, Medical Center, and NRG Park. METRO bus network is extensive but slow. Uber/Lyft widely available. BCycle bike share in urban core. Downtown tunnels connect 95 blocks underground.

_legacy_transit.label: Drive
_legacy_transit.text: San Antonio is 3 hours west via I-10. Dallas is 3.5 hours north via I-45. Austin is 2.5 hours west via TX-71/I-10.

_legacy_transit.label: Train
_legacy_transit.text: Amtrak Sunset Limited stops in Houston (three times per week, connecting New Orleans and Los Angeles). No high-speed rail yet.

_legacy_transit.label: Fly
_legacy_transit.text: George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH) is a major United hub with global routes. William P. Hobby Airport (HOU) handles Southwest Airlines and domestic flights, 20 min from downtown.

side_trips.name: Galveston Island
side_trips.distance: 50 min drive / 50 miles south on I-45
side_trips.pitch: Gulf Coast beach town with a historic downtown, seafood restaurants, Moody Gardens, and the 1894 Grand Opera House. Not Caribbean-blue water, but the Strand district and shrimp po'boys make it worth the drive.

side_trips.name: San Jacinto Battleground & Battleship Texas
side_trips.pitch: Site of the battle that won Texas independence. The San Jacinto Monument is taller than the Washington Monument and there's a museum inside. Battleship Texas (1912) is one of the last dreadnoughts.

side_trips.name: Kemah Boardwalk
side_trips.pitch: Waterfront boardwalk with rides, restaurants, and Galveston Bay views. More carnival than cultural — but kids love it and the sunset over the bay is legit.

side_trips.name: Texas Renaissance Festival (Todd Mission)
side_trips.distance: 45 min drive / 55 miles north (weekends Oct-Nov only)
side_trips.pitch: World's largest Renaissance festival. Jousting, turkey legs, mead, 200+ shops, and full immersion into a fantasy village. Weekend-only for 8 weeks in fall.

concierge.name: Space City Sam
concierge.greeting: Welcome to Houston, Space City! I'm Sam — born at Hermann Park, raised on BBQ, and I've been eating my way through this town for 30 years. What can I point you toward?

_legacy.hero_title: Houston — Beat the Heat, Find the Flavor
_legacy.hero_sub: Duck into air-conditioned museums, cool off with frozen margaritas on a shaded patio, and catch an Astros game under the retractable roof at Daikin Park.
